changes.title: Pulse speed
items: The ley pulse now travels at a steady speed along the line, and each wave comes as it reaches the next runestone: short links bring waves quickly, long ones give you longer
The speaker boot-up runs at the same speed, about 45 seconds
The Waves menu in your room now picks the pulse's speed: slow, normal, fast or off

changes.title: Posse defends
items: Your leashed animals now go first for whatever is attacking you, and spread out over your attackers instead of all piling onto one
When one of them hits a creature that's after you, it turns on that animal for a few seconds instead (only those near you, in your fight, join in)

changes.title: Sleeping legends still
items: Sleeping legends no longer turn to face you as you walk round them
